description: Central Provincial Council - Cancellation of Liquidatory of the Co-operative Societies of the Central Province
categorisation: This gazette notification concerns the cancellation of liquidation for several co-operative societies. The content deals specifically with business/commercial matters (co-operative societies, their registration status, and liquidation processes) under the authority of the Provincial Commissioner/Registrar of Co-operative Development. It does not involve government structure/personnel changes, land matters, legal frameworks, elections, public service, judicial matters, or other specialized categories, making Commercial (Type 6) the appropriate classification.
